description:
Purpose: Start here. One-page card for an agent meeting OneQAZ for the first time: what it is (public
    beta, operated by an individual, SLA: none), coverage (markets, bar intervals, universe sizes), data
    freshness (ok / degraded per pipeline component), and the measured track record with weak spots.
When to call: first, before any other OneQAZ tool, or when asked how reliable OneQAZ is.
Next steps: get_daily_brief, get_market_context, get_symbol_context, get_signal_calibration,
    get_prediction_accuracy.
Caveats: every number is read from the judgment ledgers at request time (cached 15 minutes). Cells below
    their minimum sample (track_record.*.min_n) show n and days but no rates. Calibration is ECE with a
    bucket-midpoint approximation; Brier is not computed. Profit metrics are not in this card.
Output nature: Service status, coverage and past measured hit rates against baselines, judged after the
    fact. Past hit rates do not guarantee future outcomes.
name: get_system_card
title: System Card
